description: Structural DOM diff between a step's baseline and checkpoint. `rect`, if given, only filters the output, not the comparison itself. Entries are tagged `changed`/`new`/`missing`/`displaced`. Already omits any structural difference that doesn't correspond to an actual visual diff under the step's current match settings/regions — masking a change elsewhere no longer produces DOM-diff noise. Always run this for a step before concluding a visual diff is rendering noise, and before summarizing large diffs (which are often caused by displacement — this reveals the root cause directly). The diff is computed server-side and this call may take up to ~20 seconds before responding — that is normal, do not abort early; if the call is interrupted anyway, the computation continues server-side — call this tool again with the same arguments and it resumes, usually instantly. A large diff can outlive the wait budget, in which case the result is `{"status":"computing","taskId",...}` instead of the diff — always follow its `next` field exactly (re-call this tool with the same arguments plus that taskId); the diff is ONLY available through that follow-up call, never by inferring it from images or prior context. If a diff here is the exact same underlying change you've already recorded elsewhere in this scenario, eyes_review_diff_report's `sameAs` argument lets you skip straight to reviewing just the checkpoint image for it. Resolution can happen between calls, so never reuse an earlier result in this conversation — call it again.

rect.description: Optional crop/filter rectangle in pixels. Use image sizes from eyes_inspect_steps to construct it (e.g. top quarter of a 1020×600 image = {left:0,top:0,width:1020,height:150}).

sessionUrl.description: Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present)

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the step, as returned by eyes_inspect_steps

taskId.description: ONLY a taskId from a prior {"status":"computing"} response for the same sessionUrl/stepIndex — from this tool or from eyes_inspect_evidence's composed `domDiff` — resumes checking that computation instead of resubmitting. Never invent or reuse one across steps.

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_inspect_dom_diff
